table.name: menstrual_cycle_record
table.sql: CREATE TABLE menstrual_cycle_record ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, start_time TEXT NOT NULL, total_cycle_day INTEGER NOT NULL, menstrual_period_day INTEGER NOT NULL, created_time TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now', 'localtime')) )

table.name: menstrual_record
table.sql: CREATE TABLE menstrual_record ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, menstrual_cycle TEXT NOT NULL, is_prediction INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, suggestion TEXT, flow_level INTEGER DEFAULT 0, flow_score INTEGER DEFAULT 0, pain_level INTEGER DEFAULT 0, pad_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, pad_light_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, pad_medium_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, pad_heavy_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, clot_small_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, clot_large_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0, notes TEXT, created_time TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now', 'localtime')), updated_time TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now', 'localtime')), flow_note TEXT, pain_note TEXT )

table.name: phase_anchor
table.sql: CREATE TABLE phase_anchor ( anchor_date TEXT PRIMARY KEY, phase_index INTEGER NOT NULL, created_time TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now', 'localtime')) )

table.name: reminder
table.sql: CREATE TABLE reminder ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, title TEXT NOT NULL, message TEXT, reminder_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'custom', target_day INTEGER DEFAULT 0, alarm_time TEXT, is_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, is_alarm INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ring_duration INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cycle_node INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cycle_node_end INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, repeat_type INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, repeat_config TEXT, repeat_end_day INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, created_time TEXT DEFAULT (datetime('now', 'localtime')) )
